text:
Priya: Hey finance, need help reconciling a weird corpcard charge from my Milan trip. Two lines posted: an authorization for 48.00 EUR and then a final posted charge for $58.35 USD (card statement shows merchant as BISTROROMA DCC). I never agreed to pay in USD.
Priya: I paid with the Redwood corpcard at table 7, asked for an invoice but got only a small printed receipt. I attached a photo in Expensify.
Chen: @Priya can you confirm the transaction IDs from the bank feed? Also did the receipt show a label like "You were charged in USD" or a DCC note?
Priya: Bank feed tx: 0x9a3f-4432 (Export shows descriptor 5511-BISTROROMA DCC). The receipt says "Amount: 48.00 EUR" but the terminal printed a second line "Converted amount: $58.35 (DCC)". No Italian VAT (fattura) on the receipt.
JESS: Thanks. Two separate issues: 1) Dynamic currency conversion (DCC) where merchant forces card conversion to USD. Company policy: core charges must be in local currency when possible; DCC fees are considered personal unless pre-approved. 2) VAT reclaim requires an invoice (fattura) in the local VAT format; card slip won't cut it.
Priya: I flagged merchant at the time but it was busy and I needed to catch a train. Manager said to go ahead.
Emma: Confirming I gave verbal ok for dinner due to schedule. I approve the base meal (48.00 EUR) as business. I do NOT approve the DCC markup in USD.
Maria: @Priya please upload the photo of the receipt to Expensify and set the category to "travel:meals". Add a comment with Emma's approval (can paste this Slack thread). Finance will code 48.00 EUR to travel and request personal payback for the $10-$12 DCC difference if you want.
Priya: Uploaded receipt screenshot and added Emma's quote. One follow-up: should I initiate a dispute with the card provider for the DCC?
Financebot: Reminder: disputes for corpcard items must be opened within 60 days. Run `finance corpcard dispute --tx 1795001111 --reason dcc` to start a ticket. Attach proof (receipt + merchant copy).
Chen: Also capture the merchant VAT number if you can get a fattura later. For Italy, VAT reclaim requires a proper invoice with the company's VAT ID. If you can email the restaurant and request a fattura, do that and cc finance@redwood.com.
Priya: I'll email BistroRoma for a fattura and paste the reply here. If they refuse, I'll start the dispute.
JESS: Quick note on coding: we'll post the EUR amount converted at the bank FX rate for reimbursement. The DCC markup (USD diff) will be treated as personal expense unless manager explicitly approves otherwise. If you want to avoid a personal payback, provide an explicit pre-approval email from Emma and finance will consider full reimbursement.
Emma: I can send a short email approving the base dinner only. Will send now.
Maria: Got it. Once dispute is initiated and/or fattura attached we'll finalize. Expect reconciliation on next card statement reconciliation run.
Priya: Thanks everyone 60a. Will follow up with restaurant and start the dispute if no fattura by tomorrow.
